name: podverse
description: Podverse monorepo - podcast app infrastructure, modules, and applications

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps && npm run build:tools
scripts.build:packages: node scripts/ci/run-workspaces.mjs --script build --workspaces packages/worker-commands packages/helpers packages/design-tokens packages/playback-core packages/observability packages/extension-metrics-sdk packages/integrations-web packages/helpers-validation packages/v4v-metaboost packages/v4v-helpers packages/parser-mapping packages/http-request-core packages/helpers-requests packages/management-api-requests packages/helpers-backend packages/helpers-browser packages/helpers-config packages/external-services-firebase packages/external-services-paypal packages/external-services-object-storage packages/external-services-podcast-index packages/orm packages/notifications packages/parser packages/mq packages/v4v-btc-ln
scripts.build:packages:prod: node scripts/ci/run-workspaces.mjs --script build:prod --workspaces packages/worker-commands packages/helpers packages/design-tokens packages/playback-core packages/observability packages/extension-metrics-sdk packages/integrations-web packages/helpers-validation packages/v4v-metaboost packages/v4v-helpers packages/parser-mapping packages/http-request-core packages/helpers-requests packages/management-api-requests packages/helpers-backend packages/helpers-browser packages/helpers-config packages/external-services-firebase packages/external-services-paypal packages/external-services-object-storage packages/external-services-podcast-index packages/orm packages/notifications packages/parser packages/mq packages/v4v-btc-ln
scripts.build:apps: node scripts/ci/run-workspaces.mjs --script build --workspaces apps/api apps/web apps/workers apps/management-api apps/management-web apps/web/sidecar apps/management-web/sidecar
scripts.clean:packages: find packages -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -delete && find packages -type d -name 'dist' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:apps: find apps -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -delete && find apps -type d \( -name 'dist' -o -name '.next' -o -name '.cache' -o -name 'compiled' \) -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:packages && npm run clean:apps
scripts.clean:node_modules: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/*/*/node_modules tools/*/node_modules tools/*/*/node_modules
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean:node_modules && rm -f package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.reinstall:full: npm run clean:all && npm run reinstall && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n w-cmd,helpers,v4v-mb,v4v-h,h-valid,h-map,http-core,h-req,mgmt-req,h-back,h-brow,h-conf,ext-fb,ext-pay,ext-os,ext-pi,orm,notif,parser,mq,v4v-ln -c white,blue,blueBright,blue,yellow,green,magenta,cyan,green,red,magentaBright,blueBright,greenBright,cyanBright,magentaBright,cyanBright,yellowBright,gray,red "npm run build:watch -w packages/worker-commands" "npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers" "sleep 0.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/v4v-metaboost" "sleep 1 && npm run build:watch -w packages/v4v-helpers" "sleep 5.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/v4v-btc-ln" "sleep 2 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-validation" "sleep 2.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/parser-mapping" "sleep 3 && npm run build:watch -w packages/http-request-core" "sleep 3.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-requests" "sleep 4 && npm run build:watch -w packages/management-api-requests" "sleep 4.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-backend" "sleep 5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-browser" "sleep 5.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-config" "sleep 6 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-firebase" "sleep 6.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-paypal" "sleep 7 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-object-storage" "sleep 7.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-podcast-index" "sleep 8 && npm run build:watch -w packages/orm" "sleep 9.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/notifications" "sleep 11 && npm run build:watch -w packages/parser" "sleep 12.5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/mq"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n test-assets,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 6 && npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:web:watch: concurrently -n test-assets,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 6 && npm run dev:watch -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:web-sidecar: npm run build:sidecar:web && npm run dev:sidecar -w apps/web
scripts.dev:management-web: concurrently -n test-assets,mgmt-web -c magenta,greenBright "npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 6 && npm run dev -w apps/management-web"
scripts.dev:management-web-sidecar: (test -f apps/management-web/sidecar/dist/server.js || npm run build:sidecar:management-web) && npm run dev:sidecar -w apps/management-web
scripts.dev:main:all: node scripts/check-dev-requirements.mjs && concurrently -n pkg,workers,api,web-sc,test-assets,web -c gray,yellow,blue,cyan,magenta,green "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 13.5 && npm run watch:workers" "sleep 9.5 && npm run dev:api:watch" "sleep 8.5 && npm run dev:web-sidecar" "sleep 11.5 && npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 15.5 && npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:management:all: node scripts/check-dev-requirements.mjs && concurrently -n pkg,mgmt-api,mgmt-sc,test-assets,mgmt-web -c gray,magentaBright,cyan,magenta,greenBright "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 9.5 && npm run dev:management-api:watch" "sleep 13.5 && npm run dev:management-web-sidecar" "sleep 11.5 && npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 17.5 && npm run dev -w apps/management-web"
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/check-dev-requirements.mjs && npm run build:packages:prod && npm run build:dev -w apps/api && npm run build:dev -w apps/management-api && npm run build:sidecar:web && npm run build:sidecar:management-web && concurrently -n workers,api,web-sc,test-assets,web,mgmt-api,mgmt-sc,mgmt-web -c yellow,blue,cyan,magenta,green,magentaBright,cyanBright,greenBright "npm run dev:workers" "sleep 2 && npm run dev:api" "sleep 3 && npm run dev:web-sidecar" "sleep 4 && npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 10 && npm run dev -w apps/web" "sleep 12 && npm run dev:management-api" "sleep 11 && npm run dev:management-web-sidecar" "sleep 18 && npm run dev -w apps/management-web"
scripts.dev:all:watch: node scripts/check-dev-requirements.mjs && npm run build:packages:prod && npm run build:dev -w apps/api && npm run build:dev -w apps/management-api && concurrently -n pkg,workers,api,web-sc,test-assets,web,mgmt-api,mgmt-sc,mgmt-web -c gray,yellow,blue,cyan,magenta,green,magentaBright,cyanBright,greenBright "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 13.5 && npm run watch:workers" "sleep 9.5 && npm run dev:api:watch" "sleep 8.5 && npm run dev:web-sidecar" "sleep 11.5 && npm run dev:test-assets" "sleep 15.5 && npm run dev -w apps/web" "sleep 18.5 && npm run dev:management-api:watch" "sleep 17.5 && npm run dev:management-web-sidecar" "sleep 24.5 && npm run dev -w apps/management-web"
scripts.test:e2e:api: node scripts/check-test-requirements.mjs && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/management-api
scripts.test:reports: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:web:reports
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.openapi:validate: npx --yes swagger-cli validate apps/api/openapi.yml && npx --yes swagger-cli validate apps/management-api/openapi.yml
scripts.openapi:lint: npx --yes @stoplight/spectral-cli lint -r .spectral.yaml apps/api/openapi.yml && npx --yes @stoplight/spectral-cli lint -r .spectral.yaml apps/management-api/openapi.yml
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:validate && npm run openapi:lint
scripts.i18n:all: npm run i18n:translate && npm run i18n:compile
